speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) for each year in the past five years, what are the average and median starting salaries of a social worker; and (b) whether the Ministry intends to recommend higher salaries for social workers.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And second, I am sure they are not in it for the money, but I think a good salary would help in terms of retaining social workers where I think there is a problem.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, could I ask MSF what else it is doing to retain social workers?

speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
text: Even when we do, we must know when to go out and not intervene all the time.
